title: Towards Leaving No Indic Language Behind: Building Monolingual Corpora, Benchmark and Models for Indic Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing zero-shot cross-lingual model performance (Accuracy and F1 scores) on nine diverse Natural Language Understanding (NLU) tasks across 20 Indic languages to quantify performance disparities between high-resource languages ('Winners') and low-resource languages ('Left-Behinds').
